observation_summary: The StrBuilder.contains(char) and indexOf(char, int) methods were iterating over the entire underlying character array (thisBuf.length) instead of the active portion of the string (size), causing them to search beyond the valid string content.
reasoning_summary: The bug is a procedural error in the iteration strategy. The loop condition was incorrectly using the capacity of the buffer (thisBuf.length) rather than the actual number of characters stored (size). This is a classic algorithmic error in loop bounds logic, which is best classified as Algorithm/Method.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows the loop condition changed from 'i < thisBuf.length' to 'i < this.size' in both contains(char) and indexOf(char, int).
The bug report description states: 'StrBuilder contains usages of thisBuf.length when they should use size'.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves a loop condition, it is not a guard or validation check (like a null check or bounds check on input parameters); it is the primary iteration logic of the search algorithm itself.
The issue is not an incorrect value or initialization, but the logic of the loop traversal.
